newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Independent energy firms started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Independent energy firms started.

text.p: Schroder Wertheim & Co said on Wednesday it initiated coverage of various independent energy producers, including Apache Corp.

-- The firm said it started coverage of Apache Corp with a "perform in-line" rating", Burlington Resources Inc with an outperform rating and Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co with a perform in-line rating.
-- It initiated coverage of Enron Oil & Gas Co with a perform in-line rating, Devon Energy Corp with an outperform rating, Pogo Producing Co and Seagull Energy Corp with perform in-line ratings.
-- It said it started Anadarko Petroleum Corp with a perform in-line rating and Swift Energy Co and United Meridian Corp with outperform ratings.
-- Analyst Bill Featherston was not immediately available to provide further details.
-- United Meridian was up 1/2 at 35 and Swift Energy was up 1/4 at 26-1/4. Pogo was up 1/4 at 39-3/8 and Seagull was off 1/8 at 18-1/8.
